sources.title: NGINX HTTP Upstream Module
sources.attribution: Official directive reference, checked October 3, 2026. Features depend on version and edition; the original Python selection toy is not the NGINX scheduler.

sources.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 — Delivery And Transaction Design
sources.attribution: Version 4.1 design documentation, an older version. Kafka transactions and offsets do not alone make an external effect exactly once.

sources.title: Redis Pub/Sub — Delivery Semantics
sources.attribution: Official Pub/Sub reference. At-most-once delivery and disconnected subscriber loss; not a durable acceptance channel.

sources.title: Redis XACK — Consumer Group Acknowledgement
sources.attribution: Official command reference. Removes pending group entries, not an atomic receipt for an external side effect.

sources.title: Redis XAUTOCLAIM — Pending Entry Recovery
sources.attribution: Official command reference. Available since 6.2; removed-entry reporting since 7.0. Claiming idle work does not cancel a still-running old worker.
